gaps.title: Props are not planted
gaps.detail: Every piece of set dressing sits at a nominal height with no grounding pass, so the field reads as assets laid on a flat cloth. Sample terrain height and normal for every prop, sink it slightly, give each a contact shadow. Rubric: nothing floats.

gaps.title: See-through is a dotted checkerboard
gaps.detail: Trees and cottages near the lens dissolve as a screen-door dither across 20-50 percent of the frame, and it triggers on objects not covering the hero. Rebuild kit.updateSee in src/art/props.js plus Toon.see in src/art/toon.js as a clean alpha fade at 35-45 percent with the ink outline kept, eased over 150ms, only for meshes actually covering the hero on screen.
